reply:
Hi Sofia,

1) In my 9 years building AI products I have shipped many chatbots. The latest is a support chatbot for an online shoe store that answers order and return questions for about 5,000 customers a month; I built the backend and the retrieval over the catalog.
2) We review 50 random conversations every week against a checklist and track the share marked correct; it went from 72% to 90% after we added order lookups.
3) Customers asking about orders by product name instead of order number. We added a lookup tool by email and product.
4) Order status comes from the store API, never from the model.
5) Montevideo, Uruguay, $33/h, English 8/10, 7 hours of overlap.

Regards,
Bruno
